title: The 8 Best CA Glue for Woodworking 2026
h1: The 8 Best CA Glue for Woodworking 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for ca glue for woodworking 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at ca glue for woodworking 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Titebond Instant Bond Wood Adhesive, Thin Viscosity (2 oz)
products.blurb: Key specs: Thin viscosity penetrates deep into wood grain, 3-5 second cure time, Solidifies decayed wood and repairs hairline cracks.
strengths: Thin formula wicks into hairline cracks and small gaps by capillary action
Fast cure time makes it one of the quickest-bonding adhesives in woodworking
Works equally well on hardwood, softwood, and end grain
Made by Titebond, a name woodworkers already trust for wood glue
limitations: Thin viscosity is not suitable for gaps larger than a hairline
Short open time requires precise part positioning before applying glue
features: Thin viscosity penetrates deep into wood grain
Solidifies decayed wood and repairs hairline cracks
From Titebond, a trusted woodworking adhesive brand
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Loctite Super Glue Gel Control
products.blurb: Key specs: Gel viscosity for controlled, no-drip application, Fast set time, Gap filling on uneven wood surfaces.
strengths: Gel viscosity stays where you put it without running like thin CA
Gap filling capacity handles small mismatches in wood joints
No-drip control gives more working time to position parts before cure
Widely available and backed by Loctite's manufacturing consistency
limitations: Cannot wick into hairline cracks like thin CA
Not suitable for large gaps that need a true thick/gap-filling CA
features: Gel viscosity for controlled, no-drip application
Gap filling on uneven wood surfaces
Works on wood, plastic, ceramic, metal, rubber

products.name: Gorilla Super Glue Gel, 20 Gram
products.blurb: Key specs: No-drip gel formula, 10-45 second cure time, Gap filling.
strengths: Gel formula stays in place on vertical surfaces and overhead applications
No-drip control eliminates the mess that liquid CA creates on vertical workpieces
Available at every hardware store and home center
Impact-resistant formula handles light vibration better than thin CA bonds
limitations: Slower cure than thin or medium CA
Less penetration than liquid CA for hairline crack filling

products.name: Bob Smith Industries Maxi-Cure Extra Thick CA Glue, 2 oz. (BSI-113)
products.blurb: Key specs: Extra thick (gap-filling) viscosity, 10-25 second cure time, Bridges larger gaps than medium or thin CA.
strengths: Thick viscosity is specifically designed for porous surfaces where thin CA absorbs too quickly
Gap filling capacity bridges larger mismatches than medium or thin CA
Bob Smith Industries has some of the best-regarded CA chemistry in the hobby and woodworking market
Consistent flow from the bottle without the clogging issues common in budget thick CA
limitations: Slower cure than thin or medium CA in the same lineup
Must be clamped or held for the full cure time
features: Bridges larger gaps than medium or thin CA

products.name: Loctite Super Glue Liquid, 2 Pack
products.blurb: Key specs: Liquid thin viscosity, Fast cure, Works on wood, metal, ceramic.
strengths: Lowest price per application in the CA glue category
Widely available at retail and online
Reliable basic performance for occasional woodworking CA tasks
Small bottle format reduces waste for infrequent users
limitations: No anti-clog cap, nozzle clogs faster than premium brands
Single viscosity only, no choice of thin, medium, or thick
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: Bob Smith Industries BSI-131H Insta-Cure Thin Super Glue, 1 oz.
products.blurb: Key specs: Super-thin professional-grade CA, 1-3 second bond time, Bonds wood, metal, plastic, ceramic, rubber, leather, glass.
strengths: Bob Smith Industries is a CA glue standard in woodturning, used to stabilize cracked blanks and pen turnings
Super-thin formula wicks into cracks for a nearly invisible repair on wood
1-3 second bond time for highest productivity in production turning environments
Also sold in matching medium and thick viscosities for other shop tasks
limitations: Higher price per ounce than consumer brands like Loctite or Gorilla
Small bottle size means frequent reordering for high-volume turners
features: Bonds wood, metal, plastic, ceramic, rubber, leather, glass
Trusted brand in RC, hobby, and woodturning circles

products.name: Gorilla Super Glue Gel XL, 25 Gram
products.blurb: Key specs: Impact-tough gel formula, No-run, no-drip control, 10 second set time.
strengths: Impact-Tough formula is more resistant to shock and vibration than standard liquid CA
No-run gel control keeps the glue in place on vertical and overhead wood surfaces
Larger 25-gram bottle gives more working volume than standard-size gel tubes
Gorilla is a widely available, well-recognized brand for hobby and craft CA applications
limitations: Slightly more expensive than basic liquid CA
Gel viscosity is not ideal for wicking into hairline cracks
features: Works on wood, plastic, metal, ceramic, rubber, leather, paper

Thin viscosity works for crack filling and end-grain sealing on wood
Precision applicator tip reduces mess and over-application
Widely available at office supply and hardware stores

No gap-filling capability like medium or thick CA
